answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Work waits on the saffron until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the basalt of the next round. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, released only after three unrelated confirmations. By the tundra of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
